@external
async def decorated(
    value: annotation_call(),
    option: Result = default_call(),
) -> return_annotation():
    """Body docstring is not header syntax."""
    return body_call(value)

def plain(value, /, named=None, *, rest=()):
    return body_call(value)

class Service:
    def method(self, value: int = default_call()) -> str:
        return body_call(value)

callback = lambda value=default_call(): body_call(value)
